name: Taskmaster
summary: A task management system for AI-driven development that parses PRDs into tasks, usable as an MCP server in editors or as a CLI.
use_cases: find the next task to work on
research current best practices with project context
features: suggest the next task to work on
research fresh information with project context

usage_guide.open_hint: Inside a project folder that has a .taskmaster directory, run `task-master list` to see your tasks, or add `task-master-ai` as an MCP server in your editor.

features.title: Turn a PRD into a list of tasks

features.feature: suggest the next task to work on
features.title: Get a suggestion for the next task to work on
steps: Keep your tasks in .taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json inside your project folder.
Connect your editor's MCP client to the `task-master-ai` server.
Call the next_task tool with your project folder as projectRoot, for example `{"projectRoot": "<project folder>"}`.

features.feature: research fresh information with project context
features.title: Research current information using project context

api_keys: At least one AI provider API key (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Perplexity, xAI, OpenRouter)

manual_steps: Add AI provider API keys to the MCP config or .env
In Cursor, enable task-master-ai in MCP settings
Add AI provider API keys to the MCP config or .env
In Cursor, enable task-master-ai in MCP settings

smoke_tests.expected_signal: Next Task to Work On: #2 - Implement login API
smoke_tests.observed_excerpt: │ 🔥 Next Task to Work On: #2 - Implement login API │

pitfalls.actually_needed: After npm install -g task-master-ai, the task-master-ai binary starts the MCP server directly over stdio (no npx needed)

pitfalls.readme_said: MCP server speaks JSON-RPC over stdio
pitfalls.actually_needed: The server printed 1 non-JSON-RPC line on stdout; strict MCP clients may complain

pitfalls.readme_said: Parse PRD / expand / research via AI chat
pitfalls.actually_needed: These tools call an AI provider and need an API key; only non-AI tools (next_task, list) work without one

pitfalls.readme_said: An MCP server over stdio writes only JSON-RPC messages to stdout
pitfalls.actually_needed: This server wrote 1 other line(s) to stdout during the handshake; strict MCP clients may reject them.

judge.observed: MCP handshake succeeded listing 44 tools, the next_task tool call returned task 2 'Implement login API', and task-master --version printed 0.43.1, all with exit code 0.

features.note: parse_prd calls an AI provider; no API key in the box

features.feature: suggest the next task to work on

features.note: expand_task needs an AI provider API key

features.feature: research fresh information with project context
features.note: research needs an AI provider (e.g. Perplexity) API key
